# sandboxes

Sandboxes are short-lived isolated guests an agent runs code in: their processes, files, network policy, and the templates they start from.

## POST /v1/sandbox-build-contexts

Operation `sandbox_build_context_create`.

`POST /v1/sandbox-build-contexts?tenant=&project=`. Upload a Dockerfile build context as a tar stream (`application/x-tar`). Answers `201` with its id, which one `dockerfile` build names as `context`. The size cap is `limits.max_build_context_bytes`.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | query | no | string (uuid) | Restrict to a single project. |
| `tenant` | query | no | string (uuid) | Restrict to a single tenant. |

Request body (required): `application/octet-stream`: string (binary)

Responses:

- `201`: successful creation, `application/json`: [SandboxBuildContext](schemas.md#sandboxbuildcontext)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)

## GET /v1/sandbox-capabilities

Operation `sandbox_capability_view`.

`GET /v1/sandbox-capabilities`. What this deployment can do. Read it instead of trying a feature: a feature listed `refused` is refused at the call with the same reason, and the limits here are the ones the server enforces.

Responses:

- `200`: successful operation, `application/json`: [SandboxCapabilities](schemas.md#sandboxcapabilities)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)

## POST /v1/sandbox-templates

Operation `sandbox_template_create`.

`POST /v1/sandbox-templates?tenant=&project=`. Start a template build from steps, a sandbox snapshot, an OCI image or a Dockerfile. A name already in use adds a build to that template. Answers `201` with the build; read it until it is `ready`, when the tag moves to it. `Idempotency-Key` is honoured.

| `tenant` | query | no | string (uuid) | Restrict to a single tenant. |

Request body (required): `application/json`: [SandboxTemplateCreate](schemas.md#sandboxtemplatecreate)

Responses:

- `201`: successful creation, `application/json`: [SandboxTemplateBuild](schemas.md#sandboxtemplatebuild)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)

## POST /v1/sandboxes

Operation `sandbox_create`.

`POST /v1/sandboxes?tenant=&project=`. Create a sandbox and wait up to `wait_ms` for it to run. Answers `201` with the sandbox in `running`, never in an earlier state: if it cannot run in time the request fails with a `503` and nothing is kept, so a retry is safe. `Idempotency-Key` is honoured; a replay answers the same sandbox.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | query | no | string (uuid) | Restrict to a single project. |
| `tenant` | query | no | string (uuid) | Restrict to a single tenant. |

Request body (required): `application/json`: [SandboxSpec](schemas.md#sandboxspec)

Responses:

- `201`: successful creation, `application/json`: [Sandbox](schemas.md#sandbox)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)

## GET /v1/sandboxes/{sandbox}/code/runs/{run}/stream

Operation `sandbox_code_run_stream`.

`GET /v1/sandboxes/{sandbox}/code/runs/{run}/stream`. A run's outputs over a WebSocket, subprotocol `triton.sandbox.code.v1`. Every message is one text frame holding one `SandboxCodeOutput` as JSON. The last output is `end`, sent before the close. A `since_seq` older than the kept outputs is answered from the first one kept, and the gap is in the run's `/output` page.

A refusal arrives as an HTTP status before the upgrade.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `run` | path | yes | string (uuid) |  |
| `sandbox` | path | yes | [NameOrId](schemas.md#nameorid) |  |
| `since_seq` | query | no | integer (uint64) |  |
| `Triton-Keepalive-Interval-Seconds` | header | no | integer (uint32) | Seconds between `keepalive` frames. Omitted means 50. |

Responses:

- `default`: , `*/*`

## GET /v1/sandboxes/{sandbox}/execs/{exec}/stream

Operation `sandbox_exec_stream`.

`GET /v1/sandboxes/{sandbox}/execs/{exec}/stream`. Attach to a process over a WebSocket, subprotocol `triton.sandbox.exec.v1`. Every message is one binary frame: a 12-byte header (version, type, reserved, a big-endian u64 offset) and a payload. Output frames carry the byte offset of their first byte, so a reader resumes from `since_*` after a drop and gets every byte once. Exit status arrives as one `exited` frame, sent before the close, and never in the close reason. A `since_*` offset older than the kept output gets an `overflow` frame first, naming the true resume offset.

A refusal arrives as an HTTP status before the upgrade, so a client can tell "not running" from a stream that closed.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `exec` | path | yes | string |  |
| `sandbox` | path | yes | [NameOrId](schemas.md#nameorid) |  |
| `since_pty` | query | no | integer (uint64) |  |
| `since_stderr` | query | no | integer (uint64) |  |
| `since_stdout` | query | no | integer (uint64) |  |
| `Triton-Keepalive-Interval-Seconds` | header | no | integer (uint32) | Seconds between `keepalive` frames. Omitted means 50. |

Responses:

- `default`: , `*/*`

- `200`: successful operation, `application/json`: [SandboxPreview](schemas.md#sandboxpreview)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)

## POST /v1/sandboxes/{sandbox}/resize

Operation `sandbox_resize`.

`POST /v1/sandboxes/{sandbox}/resize`. Move a stopped sandbox to another sandbox package; a running one answers `409`. The disk never shrinks. The package's traits must take the node the sandbox is on, or the answer is `409`. Answers `202` with the sandbox.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sandbox` | path | yes | [NameOrId](schemas.md#nameorid) |  |

Request body (required): `application/json`: [SandboxResizeRequest](schemas.md#sandboxresizerequest)

Responses:

- `202`: successfully enqueued operation, `application/json`: [Sandbox](schemas.md#sandbox)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)

## POST /v1/sandboxes/{sandbox}/resume

Operation `sandbox_resume`.

`POST /v1/sandboxes/{sandbox}/resume`. Restore a paused sandbox where it was: every process continues. Waits up to `wait_ms` and answers `200` with the sandbox in `running`. A stopped sandbox is started with `start`, not here.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sandbox` | path | yes | [NameOrId](schemas.md#nameorid) |  |

Request body (required): `application/json`: [SandboxResumeRequest](schemas.md#sandboxresumerequest)

Responses:

- `200`: successful operation, `application/json`: [Sandbox](schemas.md#sandbox)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)

## DELETE /v1/sandboxes/{sandbox}/sessions/{session}

Operation `sandbox_session_revoke`.

`DELETE /v1/sandboxes/{sandbox}/sessions/{session}`. Revoke a session token minted by `connect`. Takes effect at once; a stream open under the token is closed.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sandbox` | path | yes | [NameOrId](schemas.md#nameorid) |  |
| `session` | path | yes | string (uuid) |  |

Responses:

- `204`: successful deletion
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)

`GET /v1/sandboxes/{sandbox}/snapshots`. The sandbox's snapshots, oldest first.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sandbox` | path | yes | [NameOrId](schemas.md#nameorid) |  |
| `limit` | query | no | integer (uint32) | Maximum rows to return. Defaults to 50 and is clamped to 500; zero is rejected rather than treated as "default". |
| `page_token` | query | no | string | Opaque cursor from the previous response's `next_page`. Valid only for the query that produced it. A token replayed against a different selector set or sort order, or modified in any way, is a `400`; it never silently restarts the listing. |
| `sort_by` | query | no | [NameOrIdSortMode](schemas.md#nameoridsortmode) | Order the collection is walked in. Defaults to `id_ascending`. Bound into the cursor, so it cannot change part-way through a walk. |

## POST /v1/sandboxes/{sandbox}/snapshots

Operation `sandbox_snapshot_create`.

`POST /v1/sandboxes/{sandbox}/snapshots`. Take a snapshot. The guest filesystem is frozen for the moment it is taken, so the snapshot is consistent. Answers `201` with the snapshot; read it until it is `ready`. A snapshot is the source of a fork, and of a template.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sandbox` | path | yes | [NameOrId](schemas.md#nameorid) |  |

Request body (required): `application/json`: [SandboxSnapshotCreate](schemas.md#sandboxsnapshotcreate)

Responses:

- `201`: successful creation, `application/json`: [SandboxSnapshot](schemas.md#sandboxsnapshot)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)

## GET /v1/sandboxes/{sandbox}/snapshots/{snapshot}

Operation `sandbox_snapshot_view`.

`GET /v1/sandboxes/{sandbox}/snapshots/{snapshot}`. One snapshot by id or name.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sandbox` | path | yes | [NameOrId](schemas.md#nameorid) |  |
| `snapshot` | path | yes | [NameOrId](schemas.md#nameorid) | The snapshot id or name. |

Responses:

- `200`: successful operation, `application/json`: [SandboxSnapshot](schemas.md#sandboxsnapshot)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)

## DELETE /v1/sandboxes/{sandbox}/snapshots/{snapshot}

Operation `sandbox_snapshot_delete`.

`DELETE /v1/sandboxes/{sandbox}/snapshots/{snapshot}`. Remove a snapshot. Children forked from it and templates made from it keep working.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sandbox` | path | yes | [NameOrId](schemas.md#nameorid) |  |
| `snapshot` | path | yes | [NameOrId](schemas.md#nameorid) | The snapshot id or name. |

Responses:

- `204`: successful deletion
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)

## POST /v1/sandboxes/{sandbox}/start

Operation `sandbox_start`.

`POST /v1/sandboxes/{sandbox}/start`. Start a stopped sandbox without minting a session. Answers `202` with the sandbox in `starting`; read it until it is `running`. Use `connect` when a session is wanted too.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sandbox` | path | yes | [NameOrId](schemas.md#nameorid) |  |

Responses:

- `202`: successfully enqueued operation, `application/json`: [Sandbox](schemas.md#sandbox)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)

## POST /v1/sandboxes/{sandbox}/stop

Operation `sandbox_stop`.

`POST /v1/sandboxes/{sandbox}/stop`. Halt the guest and keep its filesystem; memory is not kept. Waits up to `wait_ms` and answers `200` with the sandbox in `stopped`. `start` boots it again. Use `pause` to keep memory.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sandbox` | path | yes | [NameOrId](schemas.md#nameorid) |  |

Request body (required): `application/json`: [SandboxStopRequest](schemas.md#sandboxstoprequest)

Responses:

- `200`: successful operation, `application/json`: [Sandbox](schemas.md#sandbox)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
